title: CheckboxGroup leaves All enabled when the filter matches nothing
foundBy: an independent reviewer agent, one of three asked whether each component specification still describes the component that exists

evidence.verified: Reverting the fix fails the new test, `All and None are both disabled when the filter matches nothing`, and it passes with the fix, 16 tests. `npm run ci` exits 0 with every gate run, visual:compare 104/104 at 0 differing pixels, axe 0.

details:
`components/CheckboxGroup.md:214` says both the All and None buttons are disabled when the filter matches nothing.

`src/components/CheckboxGroup.tsx:237` computes `allFilteredSelected` with a leading `filteredOptions.length > 0`, which is false for an empty result. That value reaches the button's `disabled` expression at `:106`, so All stays enabled.

None behaves as documented, because `:238` calls `every()` on an empty array and gets true.

Clicking the live All button does nothing. A reader is told both go inert, and one of them does not.

notes.text: Session agent confirmed every citation in this record against the tree at a374f2c before filing it.

Fixed by removing the length guard rather than by adding one on the other side. `every` on an empty list is true, which is already what disables None when the filter matches nothing, so dropping the guard makes the pair behave the same way for the same reason.
